name: Days of Memories 2 ~Boku no Ichiban Taisetsu na Kimi e~
original_name: Days of Memories 2 〜僕の一番大切な君へ〜
source:
Three years after the previous game, new protagonist and student teacher Amagi Yuu suddenly finds himself at risk of failing university due to Mature, the school's ice queen of a secretary. Thankfully, he has friends he can rely on, like his classmates Shizuku and Fio, his sister Hotaru, his childhood friend Kisarah, as well as Kagura, whose family shrine is the subject of his school report, and Blue Mary, a mysterious woman he just met.

July 1st to 31st, thirty-one days... will this summer change his entire life?
translation:
前作三年后，新主人公、实习教师天城勇因学校冷若冰霜的秘书Mature而突然面临无法大学毕业的危机。幸好，他还有值得依靠的朋友：同学Shizuku和Fio、妹妹Hotaru、青梅竹马Kisarah、家族神社正是其学校报告主题的Kagura，以及刚认识的神秘女子Blue Mary。

7月1日至31日，整整31天…这个夏天会改变他的一生吗？
